About the team and role
The team focuses on SaaS application protection (e.g., Microsoft Office 365, Salesforce). As the industry moves toward SaaS, data protection (backup and recovery) for these applications is critical. You’ll tackle problems at a massive scale, such as efficiently protecting data for millions of users’ emails and documents, helping drive the next generation of SaaS protection and Rubrik’s next growth engine.
Key responsibilities (time allocation)
Build large-scale, fault-tolerant distributed software systems that can scale indefinitely (35% of time)
Own, design, and develop cutting-edge solutions for Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS) for on‑prem and major cloud platforms;
Implement data management jobs for backup and recovery of virtual machines in virtualized enterprise infrastructure (Scala/Java);
Design and implement admin-facing UIs and intuitive APIs that integrate with third-party and customer applications
Perform code reviews focused on interface design, code quality, and testing strategies
Solve challenging scalability and stability problems impacting delivery of high‑scale products in accordance with quality, velocity, and coding standards (25% of time)
Analyze defects to assess and prioritize fixes; work with customers and product to understand requirements and requested customizations before implementation
Respond to critical problems in our Saas product offerings (20% of time)
resolve issues in build and test infrastructure; create solutions with robust monitoring, metrics, and automation
Partner closely with Rubrik product teams to understand customer requirements and ensure features are delivered effectively (20% of time)
What you’ll do (summary)
Design, build, and maintain Rubrik’s cloud data protection services for SaaS applications
Tackle complex distributed systems and scaling problems
Collaborate with Product Management, UI, Documentation, and Support teams
Lead projects and mentor junior engineers
Minimum qualifications
3+ years building large-scale distributed systems
Deep understanding of distributed & cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
BS in Computer Science or equivalent
Strong code review and testing practices
Proven experience in data structures, software design, and systems analysis
Preferred qualifications
Proficiency in one or more: Go, Scala, Python
Experience with Bazel, Git, and GitHub
Experience establishing/maintaining automated build systems
The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US Pay Range
$158,000—$237,000 USD

Inclusion @ Rubrik
At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.
Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.
Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:
Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.
